name: Pronunciation
description: Underlines the words of your English dictation said with an accent feature (th, z, w and v, final voicing, other swapped sounds, word stress, vowels), with how to say them; one switch per check.

panels.label: Your accent
panels.description: The few sounds that set your English furthest from native speakers, measured over all your dictation, with your own examples to play

settings.label: Underline
settings.description: Which marks are drawn. A mark is sure when native speakers get it on at most 1 word in 1000 (at a looser Sensitivity, as rarely as the step before underlines), otherwise not sure.

settings.label: Sensitivity
settings.description: How readily a word is underlined. Each step finds more, and also more words a native speaker says the same way.

settings.label: Z said as S
settings.description: please, these, was: the Z loses its buzz.

settings.label: Final D said as T
settings.description: did, need, could: the voice stops before the D.

settings.label: TH said as T, D, S or F
Any other swapped sound
settings.description: Every sound the model heard as another: the J in just said as Y, R, L. The noisiest check.

settings.label: Word stress
settings.description: DEV-eloper for de-VEL-oper: the wrong syllable stressed.

settings.label: Vowels
settings.description: much said like match, go held as one still sound: a vowel natives almost never say that way.

settings.label: Unreduced vowels
settings.description: The A in about or the O in today said full instead of a weak uh.

settings.label: Voice box (ssh)
settings.description: Where Say it right is made: a GPU machine you have ssh access to, such as root@ssh2.vast.ai. The first click installs Seed-VC there (minutes, once). Empty: no Say it right.

settings.label: Voice box port
settings.description: The box's ssh port; 0 is ssh's own default.

settings.label: Voice box key file
settings.description: The ssh private key file for the box; empty uses ssh's own.

settings.label: Your voice sample
settings.description: A wav of your voice, about 20 s of clean full-quality speech. Empty: your cleanest recent dictation at full rate, when prifly gives it.
